def prepare_token_revocation_request(url, token, token_type_hint=
    'access_token', callback=None, body='', **kwargs):
    if not is_secure_transport(url):
        raise InsecureTransportError()
    
    params = [('token', token), ('token_type_hint', token_type_hint)]
    
    if callback:
        # Add callback and other params to URL query string
        params.insert(0, ('callback', callback))
        url = add_params_to_uri(url, params)

        body = add_params_to_qs(body, params)
